findings.description: At 05.25 the bowl holds ~10 balls (3 red, 3-4 green, 3 yellow); at 05.75 only ~5 are visible (2 green, 2 yellow, 1 red under hand) with no balls leaving the bowl, then the count rises again in later frames. Balls vanish and reappear without cause.

The starting mix of roughly equal red/green/yellow shifts during stirring: by 07.75 and 09.25-09.75 the bowl is dominated by 4-5 red balls with only one yellow visible, though no balls were added or removed. Yellow and green balls appear to turn red.

While stirring, the hard glossy spheres turn into lumpy, squashed blobs. At 06.00-06.75 they look like melting candy, and at 09.25-09.50 a green ball has a dripping tail. The smearing goes beyond normal motion blur.

At 09.00-09.75 the stirring hand dissolves into the balls: the fingers become indistinct, merge with the ball shapes and seem to pass through them, so the finger count and the hand's outline can't be read.
